description: Represents a rectangular range of cells within a spreadsheet sheet. Supports parsing from standard A1 notation (e.g. A1, B2:D10, $A$1).

members.name: ColumnIndexToLetters
members.description: Converts a zero-based column index to Excel-style letters (0=A, 25=Z, 26=AA).

members.name: ColumnLettersToIndex
members.description: Converts Excel-style column letters to a zero-based column index.

members.name: Contains
members.description: Returns true if the given cell coordinates are within this range.

members.name: Parse
members.description: Parses a range string in A1 notation. Supports single cells (A1), ranges (A1:B10), and absolute references ($A$1).

members.name: ToString
members.description: Returns the A1 notation string for this range.
